evals.prompt: Run learnings-sweep for ticket t-96a8, which has an UNPROMOTED .tickets/t-96a8/learnings.md.
evals.expected_output: Reads only .tickets/t-96a8/learnings.md (no glob of .tickets/*), upserts one row for t-96a8 into root LEARNINGS.md's table with Status UNPROMOTED, and rewrites the top-of-file stamp.
expectations: Does not glob or read any other .tickets/<id>/learnings.md file
LEARNINGS.md contains exactly one row for t-96a8 after the run
The row's Status cell is UNPROMOTED
The top-of-file 'learnings-sweep last run' stamp is updated to the current run time

evals.prompt: Run learnings-sweep --full in a repo with three tickets (t-96a8, t-ddc8, t-4d26) that each have an UNPROMOTED learnings.md, and an empty/absent LEARNINGS.md.
evals.expected_output: Globs .tickets/*/learnings.md, creates LEARNINGS.md with three rows (one per ticket, newest first by date), each Status UNPROMOTED, with the canon:learnings markers and stamp line present.
expectations: LEARNINGS.md is created with exactly three rows, one per ticket
Rows are ordered newest date first
Each row links to its source .tickets/<id>/learnings.md
The <!-- canon:learnings:BEGIN --> / <!-- canon:learnings:END --> markers wrap the table

evals.prompt: Run learnings-sweep <id> for a ticket whose learnings.md status is still UNPROMOTED, then check whether the skill ever wrote to critique/canon-learnings.md or standards/.
evals.expected_output: The skill only edits LEARNINGS.md (and LEARNINGS-archive.md if overflow triggers archiving of non-UNPROMOTED rows). It never writes to critique/canon-learnings.md or any file under standards/, and never changes the row's Status away from UNPROMOTED.
expectations: No write to any file under standards/ occurs
The ticket's row in LEARNINGS.md keeps Status UNPROMOTED after the run

evals.prompt: Run learnings-sweep <id> where LEARNINGS.md's managed block is already at the 80-line cap and every existing row's Status is UNPROMOTED.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not archive any UNPROMOTED row (none are eligible), does not block or error, and prints an advisory that the cap is exceeded and a promotion/triage pass is due.
expectations: No row is moved to LEARNINGS-archive.md
The operation completes without blocking or erroring
An advisory message about the 80-line cap and pending triage is surfaced

evals.prompt: Run learnings-sweep <id> for a ticket that has no .tickets/<id>/learnings.md file at all.
evals.expected_output: The skill reports that there is nothing to sweep for that ticket and stops, without creating a fabricated row or erroring out the sprint-complete flow.
expectations: No row is added to LEARNINGS.md for that ticket
The skill reports the absence rather than failing silently or fabricating content
Does not attempt --full-mode behavior as a fallback
